name: Kashiwagi Tsubasa
source:
A third-year student at the academy. The protagonist, [url=/c91518]Dankonmaru[/url]'s, older sister.

An excellent student, incredibly athletic, with superb communication skills and a fantastic figure—a perfect girl.

She has a boyfriend who is nationally famous at his sports.

They are a popular and beautiful couple at school, admired by all the students.

[From [url=http://gyutto.com/i/item152444?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
